sentences.zh: 方澤則以黃琮束帛，夏至之日，禘崐崙皇地祇於其上，以武明皇后配。

translations.literal: The Square Marsh used a yellow jade tube and bundled silks; on the summer solstice, Kunlun Queen Earth Numen was sacrificed to upon it, with Empress Wuming as associate.
translations.idiomatic: The Square Marsh rite used a yellow jade cong and bundled silks; on the summer solstice, Kunlun Queen Earth Numen was sacrificed to upon it, with Empress Wuming as associate.

sentences.zh: 其神州之神、社稷、岱岳、沂鎮、會稽鎮、云云山、亭亭山、蒙山、羽山、嶧山、崧岳、霍岳、衡鎮、荊山、內方山、大別山、敷淺原山、桐柏山、陪尾山、華岳、太岳鎮、積石山、龍門山、江山、岐山、荊山、嶓冢山、壺口山、雷首山、底柱山、析城山、王屋山、西傾朱圉山、鳥鼠同穴山、熊耳山、敦物山、蔡蒙山、梁山、岷山、武功山、太白山、恒岳、醫無閭山鎮、陰山、白登山、碣石山、太行山、狼山、封龍山、漳山、宣務山、閼山、方山、苟山、狹龍山、淮水、東海、泗水、沂水、淄水、濰水、江水、南海、漢水、穀水、洛水、伊水、漾水、沔水、河水、西海、黑水、澇水、渭水、涇水、酆水、濟水、北海、松水、京水、桑乾水、漳水、呼沲水、衞水、洹水、延水，並從祀。

translations.literal: The Spirit of the Central Land, altars of soil and grain, Mount Dai, Mount Yi guardian peak, Kuaiji guardian peak, Cloud Cloud Mountain, Tingting Mountain, Mount Meng, Mount Yu, Mount Yi, Mount Song, Mount Huo, Heng guardian peak, Mount Jing, Mount Neifang, Great Pie Mountain, Fushan Plain, Mount Tongbai, Mount Peiwei, Mount Hua, Mount Tainyue guardian peak, Mount Jishi, Mount Longmen, Mount Jiang, Mount Qi, Mount Jing, Mount Bozhong, Mount Hukou, Mount Leishou, Mount Dizhu, Mount Xicheng, Mount Wangwu, Mount Xiqing Zhuyuan, Mount Niaoshutongxue, Mount Xionger, Mount Dunwu, Mount Caimeng, Mount Liang, Mount Min, Mount Wugong, Mount Taibai, Mount Heng, Mount Yiwulü guardian peak, Mount Yin, Mount Baideng, Mount Jieshi, Mount Taihang, Mount Lang, Mount Fenglong, Mount Zhang, Mount Xuanwu, Mount Yanshan, Mount Fang, Mount Gou, Mount Xialong, Mount Huai River, Eastern Sea, Si River, Yi River, Zi River, Wei River, Yangtze River, Southern Sea, Han River, Gu River, Luo River, Yi River, Yang River, Mian River, Yellow River, Western Sea, Black River, Lao River, Wei River, Jing River, Feng River, Ji River, Northern Sea, Song River, Jing River, Sanggan River, Zhang River, Hutuo River, Wei River, Huan River, Yan River—all were associated sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit of the Central Land, altars of soil and grain, Mount Tai, guardian peaks, mountains, rivers, and seas too numerous to list—all received associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其神州位在青陛之北甲寅地，社位赤陛之西未地，稷位白陛之南庚地；

translations.literal: The Central Land's position was at the north of the green steps in the jiayin position; the soil altar at the west of the red steps in the wei position; the grain altar at the south of the white steps in the geng position;
translations.idiomatic: The Central Land occupied the jiayin position north of the green steps; the soil altar the wei position west of the red steps; the grain altar the geng position south of the white steps;

sentences.zh: 自餘並內壝之內，內向，各如其方。

translations.literal: The rest were all within the inner enclosure, facing inward, each according to its direction.
translations.idiomatic: All others were within the inner enclosure, facing inward according to their directions.

sentences.zh: 合用牲十二，儀同圓丘。

translations.literal: In total twelve victims were used; ceremony the same as the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve victims were used in total; the ceremony matched the Round Mound rite.

sentences.zh: 其後諸儒定禮，圓丘改以冬至云。

translations.literal: Afterward the Confucian scholars fixed the rites—the Round Mound changed to use the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Later Confucian scholars fixed the rites—the Round Mound rite was moved to the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 其南北郊則歲一祀，皆以正月上辛。

translations.literal: The Northern and Southern suburbs were once per year—both on the first xin of the first month.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern and Southern suburbs were performed once per year—both on the first xin day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 南郊為壇於國南，廣輪三十六尺，高九尺，四面各一陛。

translations.literal: The Southern Suburb altar south of the capital, circumference thirty-six chi, height nine chi; one set of steps on each of four sides.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Suburb altar south of the capital measured thirty-six chi in circumference and nine chi in height, with steps on each of four sides.

sentences.zh: 為三壝，內壝去壇二十五步，中壝、外壝相去如內壝。

translations.literal: Three enclosing walls; the inner wall twenty-five paces from the altar; middle and outer walls spaced as the inner.
translations.idiomatic: Three enclosing walls surrounded it; the inner stood twenty-five paces from the altar; middle and outer walls were similarly spaced.

sentences.zh: 四面各通一門。

translations.literal: Four sides each with one gate.
translations.idiomatic: Each side had one gate.

sentences.zh: 又為大營於外壝之外，廣輪二百七十步。

translations.literal: Also a great encampment outside the outer wall, circumference two hundred seventy paces.
translations.idiomatic: A great encampment outside the outer wall measured two hundred seventy paces in circumference.

sentences.zh: 營塹廣一丈，深八尺，四面各一門。

translations.literal: Encampment moat one zhang wide, eight chi deep; one gate on each of four sides.
translations.idiomatic: The encampment moat was one zhang wide and eight chi deep, with one gate on each side.

sentences.zh: 又為燎壇於中壝之外丙地，廣輪二十七尺，高一尺八寸，四面各一陛。

translations.literal: Also a firewood altar outside the middle wall at the bing position, circumference twenty-seven chi, height one chi eight cun; one set of steps on each of four sides.
translations.idiomatic: A firewood altar outside the middle wall at the bing position measured twenty-seven chi in circumference and one chi eight cun in height, with steps on four sides.

sentences.zh: 祀所感帝靈威仰於壇，以高祖神武皇帝配。

translations.literal: The Responsive Emperor Lingweiyang was sacrificed to upon the altar, with High Ancestor Emperor Shenwu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: The Responsive Emperor Lingweiyang was sacrificed to upon the altar, with High Ancestor Emperor Shenwu as associate.

sentences.zh: 禮用四圭有邸，幣各如方色。

translations.literal: The rite used four gui with base; silks each according to the direction's color.
translations.idiomatic: The rite used four gui jade tablets with base; silks according to each direction's color.

sentences.zh: 其上帝及配帝，各用騂特牲一，儀燎同圓丘。

translations.literal: The Supreme Lord and associate lords each used one red bull victim; ceremony and firewood burning the same as the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Lord and associate lords each received one red bull; ceremony and firewood burning matched the Round Mound rite.

sentences.zh: 其北郊則為壇如南郊壇，為瘞坎如方澤坎，祀神州神於其上，以武明皇后配。

translations.literal: The Northern Suburb altar was made like the Southern Suburb altar; a burial pit like the Square Marsh pit; the Spirit of the Central Land was sacrificed to upon it, with Empress Wuming as associate.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Suburb altar matched the Southern Suburb altar; its burial pit matched the Square Marsh pit; the Spirit of the Central Land was sacrificed to upon it, with Empress Wuming as associate.

sentences.zh: 禮用兩圭有邸，各用黃牲一，儀瘞如北郊。

translations.literal: The rite used two gui with base; each used one yellow victim; ceremony and burial like the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The rite used two gui jade tablets with base; each direction used one yellow victim; ceremony and burial followed Northern Suburb precedent.

sentences.zh: 後周憲章姬周，祭祀之式，多依儀禮。

translations.literal: Later Zhou took the Zhou of Ji as its model; sacrificial forms largely followed the Ceremonial Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Zhou modeled itself on the Zhou of Ji; sacrificial forms largely followed the Ceremonial Rites.

sentences.zh: 司量掌為壇之制，圓丘三成，成崇一丈二尺，深二丈。

translations.literal: The Director of Measures presided over altar construction: Round Mound three tiers; each tier one zhang two chi high, two zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Measures presided over altar construction: the Round Mound had three tiers, each one zhang two chi high and two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 上徑六丈，十有二階，每等十有二節。

translations.literal: Upper diameter six zhang; twelve steps; each tier twelve sections.
translations.idiomatic: The upper diameter was six zhang, with twelve steps; each tier had twelve sections.

sentences.zh: 在國陽七里之郊。

translations.literal: Seven li yang from the capital's suburb.
translations.idiomatic: It stood seven li yang from the capital's suburb.

sentences.zh: 圓壝徑三百步，內壝半之。

translations.literal: Round enclosure diameter three hundred paces; inner enclosure half of it.
translations.idiomatic: The round enclosure measured three hundred paces in diameter; the inner enclosure, half that.

sentences.zh: 方一成，下崇一丈，徑六丈八尺，上崇五尺，方四丈，八方，方一階，階十級，級一尺。

translations.literal: Square mound one tier; lower height one zhang, diameter six zhang eight chi; upper height five chi, square four zhang; eight directions; one set of steps on each side, ten levels per step, one chi per level.
translations.idiomatic: The square mound had one tier: lower height one zhang, diameter six zhang eight chi; upper height five chi, four zhang square; eight directions with one set of steps per side, ten levels of one chi each.

sentences.zh: 方丘在國陰六里之郊。

translations.literal: Square mound six li yin from the capital's suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The square mound stood six li yin from the capital's suburb.

sentences.zh: 丘一成，八方，下崇一丈，方六丈八尺，上崇五尺，方四丈。

translations.literal: Mound one tier; eight directions; lower height one zhang, square six zhang eight chi; upper height five chi, square four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The mound had one tier in eight directions: lower height one zhang, six zhang eight chi square; upper height five chi, four zhang square.

sentences.zh: 方一階，尺一級。

translations.literal: One set of steps on each side; one chi per level.
translations.idiomatic: One set of steps on each side, one chi per level.

sentences.zh: 其壝八面，徑百二十步，內壝半之。

translations.literal: Its enclosure eight-sided, diameter one hundred twenty paces; inner enclosure half of it.
translations.idiomatic: Its eight-sided enclosure measured one hundred twenty paces in diameter; the inner enclosure, half that.

sentences.zh: 南郊為方壇於國南五里。

translations.literal: Southern Suburb square altar five li south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Suburb square altar stood five li south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 其崇一丈二尺，其廣四丈。

translations.literal: Height one zhang two chi; width four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: It was one zhang two chi high and four zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 其壝方百二十步，內壝半之。

translations.literal: Its enclosure square one hundred twenty paces; inner enclosure half of it.
translations.idiomatic: Its square enclosure measured one hundred twenty paces; the inner enclosure, half that.

sentences.zh: 神州之壇，崇一丈，方四丈，在北郊方丘之右。

translations.literal: Spirit of the Central Land altar, height one zhang, square four zhang—north of the Northern Suburb square mound, to its right.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit of the Central Land altar stood one zhang high and four zhang square, north of the Northern Suburb square mound, to its right.

sentences.zh: 其壝如方丘。

translations.literal: Its enclosure like the square mound.
translations.idiomatic: Its enclosure matched the square mound.

sentences.zh: 其祭圓丘及南郊，並正月上辛。

translations.literal: Sacrifices at the Round Mound and Southern Suburb both on the first xin of the first month.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices at the Round Mound and Southern Suburb both fell on the first xin day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 圓丘則以其先炎帝神農氏配昊天上帝於其上。

translations.literal: The Round Mound paired the former Emperor Shennong with August Heaven Supreme Lord upon it.
translations.idiomatic: At the Round Mound, the former Emperor Shennong was paired with August Heaven Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 五方上帝、日月、內官、中官、外官、眾星，並從祀。

translations.literal: Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun, Moon, inner officials, central officials, outer officials, and multitude of stars—all were associated sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun, Moon, inner officials, central officials, outer officials, and the multitude of stars—all received associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘蒼輅，載玄冕，備大駕而行。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the dark chariot, wore the dark cap, with full imperial escort to perform.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode the dark chariot, wore the dark ceremonial cap, and with full imperial escort performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 預祭者皆蒼服。

translations.literal: Those participating in the preliminary sacrifice all wore dark robes.
translations.idiomatic: All participants in the preliminary sacrifice wore dark robes.

sentences.zh: 南郊，以始祖獻侯莫那配所感帝靈威仰於其上。

translations.literal: Southern Suburb: the Founding Ancestor Duke Monajia was paired with the Responsive Emperor Lingweiyang upon it.
translations.idiomatic: At the Southern Suburb, Founding Ancestor Duke Monajia was paired with the Responsive Emperor Lingweiyang.

sentences.zh: 北郊方丘，則以神農配后地之祇。

translations.literal: Northern Suburb square mound: Shennong was paired with Queen Earth Numen.
translations.idiomatic: At the Northern Suburb square mound, Shennong was paired with Queen Earth Numen.

sentences.zh: 神州則以獻侯莫那配焉。

translations.literal: Spirit of the Central Land: Duke Monajia was paired.
translations.idiomatic: At the Spirit of the Central Land altar, Duke Monajia was paired.

sentences.zh: 其用牲之制，祀昊天上帝，祭皇地祇及五帝、日月、五星、十二辰、四望、五官，各以其方色毛。

translations.literal: Regulations for victims: sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord, Queen Earth Numen, Five Emperors, Sun, Moon, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, Four Outlooks, Five Officials—each used victims of its direction's color.
translations.idiomatic: Victim regulations: sacrifices to August Heaven Supreme Lord, Queen Earth Numen, Five Emperors, Sun, Moon, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, Four Outlooks, and Five Officials each used victims of the appropriate directional color.

sentences.zh: 宗廟以黃，社稷以黝，散祭祀用純，表狢磔禳用厖。

translations.literal: Ancestral temple used yellow; altars of soil and grain used dark; miscellaneous sacrifices used pure; expiation and exorcism used mottled.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple used yellow victims; altars of soil and grain, dark; miscellaneous sacrifices, pure-colored; expiation and exorcism, mottled.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命，欲新制度。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor received the mandate, he wished to establish new institutions.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor received the mandate, he sought to establish new institutions.

sentences.zh: 乃命國子祭酒辛彥之議定祀典。

translations.literal: He then commanded the Director of the Imperial Academy Xin Yanzhi to deliberate and fix the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Imperial Academy Director Xin Yanzhi to deliberate and fix the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 為圓丘於國之南，太陽門外道東二里。

translations.literal: A Round Mound was made south of the capital, two li east of the road outside the Taiyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: A Round Mound was erected south of the capital, two li east of the road outside the Taiyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 其丘四成，各高八尺一寸。

translations.literal: The mound had four tiers; each tier eight chi one cun high.
translations.idiomatic: The mound had four tiers, each eight chi one cun high.

sentences.zh: 下成廣二十丈，再成廣十五丈，又三成廣十丈，四成廣五丈。

translations.literal: Lower tier twenty zhang wide; second tier fifteen zhang; third tier ten zhang; fourth tier five zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The lower tier was twenty zhang wide; the second, fifteen zhang; the third, ten zhang; the fourth, five zhang.

sentences.zh: 再歲冬至之日，祀昊天上帝於其上，以太祖武元皇帝配。

translations.literal: Every other year on the winter solstice, August Heaven Supreme Lord was sacrificed to upon it, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Every other winter solstice, August Heaven Supreme Lord was sacrificed to upon it, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.

sentences.zh: 五方上帝、日月、五星、內官四十二座、次官一百三十六座、外官一百一十一座、眾星三百六十座，並皆從祀。

translations.literal: Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun, Moon, Five Stars, inner officials forty-two seats, secondary officials one hundred thirty-six seats, outer officials one hundred eleven seats, multitude of stars three hundred sixty seats—all were associated sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun, Moon, Five Stars, forty-two inner official seats, one hundred thirty-six secondary official seats, one hundred eleven outer official seats, and three hundred sixty multitude-of-stars seats—all received associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 上帝、日月在丘之第二等，北斗五星、十二辰、河漢、內官在丘第三等，二十八宿、中官在丘第四等，外官在內壝之內，眾星在內壝之外。

translations.literal: Supreme Lord and Sun and Moon on the mound's second tier; Northern Dipper, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, River Han, and inner officials on the third tier; Twenty-eight Lodges and central officials on the fourth tier; outer officials within the inner enclosure; multitude of stars outside the inner enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Lord, Sun, and Moon occupied the mound's second tier; Northern Dipper, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, River Han, and inner officials the third; Twenty-eight Lodges and central officials the fourth; outer officials within the inner enclosure; the multitude of stars outside it.

sentences.zh: 其牲，上帝、配帝用蒼犢二，五帝、日月用方色犢各一，五星已下用羊豕各九。

translations.literal: Victims: Supreme Lord and associate lords used two dark calves; Five Emperors and Sun and Moon each one direction-colored calf; Five Stars and below used nine sheep and nine pigs each.
translations.idiomatic: Victims: Supreme Lord and associate lords received two dark calves; Five Emperors and Sun and Moon each one direction-colored calf; Five Stars and below, nine sheep and nine pigs each.

sentences.zh: 為方丘於宮城之北十四里。

translations.literal: A Square Mound was made fourteen li north of the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: A Square Mound was erected fourteen li north of the palace city.

sentences.zh: 其丘再成，成高五尺，下成方十丈，上成方五丈。

translations.literal: The mound had two tiers; each tier five chi high; lower tier ten zhang square; upper tier five zhang square.
translations.idiomatic: The mound had two tiers, each five chi high: the lower ten zhang square, the upper five zhang square.

sentences.zh: 夏至之日，祭皇地祇於其上，以太祖配。

translations.literal: On the summer solstice, Queen Earth Numen was sacrificed to upon it, with the Founding Ancestor as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the summer solstice, Queen Earth Numen was sacrificed to upon it, with the Founding Ancestor as associate.

sentences.zh: 神州、迎州、冀州、戎州、拾州、柱州、營州、咸州、陽州九州山、海、川、林、澤、丘陵、墳衍、原隰，並皆從祀。

translations.literal: Spirit of the Central Land, Ying Province, Ji Province, Rong Province, Shi Province, Zhu Province, Ying Province, Xian Province, Yang Province—Nine Provinces' mountains, seas, rivers, forests, marshes, mounds, tombs, plains, and lowlands—all were associated sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit of the Central Land and the Nine Provinces' mountains, seas, rivers, forests, marshes, mounds, tombs, plains, and lowlands—all received associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 地祇及配帝在壇上，用黃犢二。

translations.literal: Queen Earth Numen and associate lords on the altar used two yellow calves.
translations.idiomatic: Queen Earth Numen and associate lords on the altar received two yellow calves.

sentences.zh: 神州九州神座於第二等八陛之間：神州東南方，迎州南方，冀州、戎州西南方，拾州西方，柱州西北方，營州北方，咸州東北方，陽州東方，各用方色犢一。

translations.literal: Spirit of the Central Land and Nine Provinces spirit seats on the second tier between the eight sets of steps: Spirit of the Central Land southeast; Ying Province south; Ji and Rong Provinces southwest; Shi Province west; Zhu Province northwest; Ying Province north; Xian Province northeast; Yang Province east—each used one direction-colored calf.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit of the Central Land and Nine Provinces occupied the second tier between eight sets of steps: Spirit of the Central Land southeast; Ying Province south; Ji and Rong southwest; Shi west; Zhu northwest; Ying north; Xian northeast; Yang east—each with one direction-colored calf.

sentences.zh: 九州山海已下，各依方面八陛之間。

translations.literal: Nine Provinces' mountains, seas, and below—each according to its direction between the eight sets of steps.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Provinces' mountains, seas, and below were placed according to direction between the eight sets of steps.

sentences.zh: 其冀州山林川澤，丘陵墳衍，於壇之南，少西，加羊豕各九。

translations.literal: Ji Province's mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes, mounds, tombs, and plains—south of the altar, slightly west—added nine sheep and nine pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Province's mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, mounds, tombs, and plains—south of the altar, slightly west—received an additional nine sheep and nine pigs.

sentences.zh: 南郊為壇於國之南，太陽門外道西一里。

translations.literal: Southern Suburb altar south of the capital, one li west of the road outside the Taiyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Suburb altar stood south of the capital, one li west of the road outside the Taiyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 去宮十里。

translations.literal: Ten li from the palace.
translations.idiomatic: It stood ten li from the palace.

sentences.zh: 壇高七尺，廣四丈。

translations.literal: Altar seven chi high, four zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: The altar was seven chi high and four zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 孟春上辛，祠所感帝赤熛怒於其上，以太祖武元皇帝配。

translations.literal: On the first xin of the first spring month, the Responsive Emperor Chibenu was sacrificed to upon it, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the first xin day of the first spring month, the Responsive Emperor Chibenu was sacrificed to upon it, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.

sentences.zh: 其禮四圭有邸，牲用騂犢二。

translations.literal: The rite used four gui with base; victims used two red calves.
translations.idiomatic: The rite used four gui jade tablets with base; victims were two red calves.

sentences.zh: 北郊孟冬祭神州之神，以太祖武元皇帝配。

translations.literal: Northern Suburb in the first winter month sacrificed to the Spirit of the Central Land, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first winter month the Northern Suburb sacrificed to the Spirit of the Central Land, with Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan as associate.

sentences.zh: 牲用犢二。

translations.literal: Victims used two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Two calves were used as victims.

sentences.zh: 凡大祀，齋官皆於其晨集尚書省，受誓戒。

translations.literal: For all great sacrifices, fasting officials all assembled at the Secretariat at dawn on the appointed day to receive the oath of abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: For all great sacrifices, fasting officials assembled at the Secretariat at dawn on the appointed day to receive the oath of abstinence.

sentences.zh: 散齋四日，致齋三日。

translations.literal: Initial fasting four days; concentrated fasting three days.
translations.idiomatic: Initial fasting lasted four days; concentrated fasting, three.

sentences.zh: 祭前一日，晝漏上水五刻，到祀所，沐浴，著明衣，咸不得聞見衰絰哭泣。

translations.literal: One day before the sacrifice, at the fifth watch after daybreak's water clock, arriving at the sacrifice site, bathing, putting on bright robes—all must not hear or see mourning garments or weeping.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the sacrifice, at the fifth watch after daybreak, officials arrived at the site, bathed, and donned bright robes—none might encounter mourning garments or weeping.

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝、五方上帝、日月、皇地祇、神州社稷、宗廟等為大祀，星辰、五祀、四望等為中祀，司中、司命、風師、雨師及諸星、諸山川等為小祀。

translations.literal: August Heaven Supreme Lord, Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun and Moon, Queen Earth Numen, Spirit of the Central Land and altars of soil and grain, ancestral temple—these were great sacrifices; stars, Five Sacrifices, Four Outlooks—these were medium sacrifices; Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, Rain Master and various stars and various mountains and rivers—these were small sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: August Heaven Supreme Lord, Five Direction Supreme Lords, Sun and Moon, Queen Earth Numen, Spirit of the Central Land, altars of soil and grain, and ancestral temple were great sacrifices; stars, Five Sacrifices, and Four Outlooks were medium sacrifices; Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, Rain Master, various stars, and various mountains and rivers were small sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 大祀養牲，在滌九旬，中祀三旬，小祀一旬。

translations.literal: Great sacrifices reared victims for ninety days; medium sacrifices thirty days; small sacrifices ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Great sacrifices reared victims for ninety days; medium sacrifices, thirty; small sacrifices, ten.

sentences.zh: 其牲方色難備者，聽以純色代。

translations.literal: When direction-colored victims were hard to prepare, pure-colored victims were permitted as substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: When direction-colored victims were unavailable, pure-colored victims were permitted as substitutes.

sentences.zh: 告祈之牲者不養。

translations.literal: Victims for announcement and prayer were not reared.
translations.idiomatic: Victims for announcement and prayer rites were not reared in advance.

sentences.zh: 祭祀犧牲，不得捶扑。

translations.literal: Sacrificial victims must not be beaten.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial victims must not be beaten.

sentences.zh: 其死則埋之。

translations.literal: If they died, they were buried.
translations.idiomatic: If they died prematurely, they were buried.

sentences.zh: 初帝既受周禪，恐黎元未愜，多說符瑞以耀之。

translations.literal: When the emperor first received the Zhou abdication, fearing the people were not yet content, he spoke much of portents and omens to glorify it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first received the Northern Zhou abdication, fearing the people were not yet reconciled, he proclaimed numerous portents and omens.

sentences.zh: 其或造作而進者，不可勝計。

translations.literal: Those who fabricated and presented them—countless.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fabricated and presented them were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 仁壽元年冬至祠南郊，置昊天上帝及五方天帝位，並于壇上，如封禪禮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Renshou, winter solstice sacrifice at the Southern Suburb—August Heaven Supreme Lord and Five Direction Heavenly Emperors' seats were both placed upon the altar, as in the feng and shan rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Renshou 1, the winter solstice sacrifice at the Southern Suburb placed August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Direction Heavenly Emperors' seats together upon the altar, as in the feng and shan rites.

sentences.zh: 板曰：

translations.literal: The placard read:
translations.idiomatic: The placard read:

sentences.zh: :維仁壽元年，歲次作噩，嗣天子臣堅，敢昭告于昊天上帝。

translations.literal: : In the first year of Renshou, year cycle zuoe, the succeeding Son of Heaven Chen Jian, dare solemnly announce to August Heaven Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: In Renshou 1, year cycle zuoe, the succeeding Son of Heaven Chen Jian solemnly announces to August Heaven Supreme Lord:

sentences.zh: 璇璣運行，大明南至。

translations.literal: The armillary sphere turns; the great light reaches the south.
translations.idiomatic: The armillary sphere turns; the great light reaches its southern limit.

sentences.zh: 臣蒙上天恩造，羣靈降福，撫臨率土，安養兆人。

translations.literal: Your subject received Heaven's gracious creation; the multitude of spirits bestowed blessings; overseeing and comforting all lands, nurturing the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: I have received Heaven's gracious creation; the multitude of spirits have bestowed blessings; I oversee and comfort all lands and nurture the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 顧惟虛薄，德化未暢，夙夜憂懼，不敢荒怠。

translations.literal: Reflecting on my emptiness and inadequacy, virtue and transformation not yet widespread—day and night anxious and fearful, not daring to be negligent.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on my emptiness and inadequacy, with virtue and transformation not yet widespread—I am anxious day and night and dare not be negligent.

sentences.zh: 天地靈祇，降錫休瑞，鏡發區宇，昭彰耳目。

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth's numina descended and bestowed auspicious omens, mirroring the realm, manifest to eyes and ears.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth's numina have descended and bestowed auspicious omens, manifest throughout the realm to all eyes and ears.

sentences.zh: 爰始登極，蒙授龜圖，遷都定鼎，醴泉出地，平陳之歲，龍引舟師。

translations.literal: At first ascending the throne, receiving the tortoise chart; moving the capital and fixing the cauldron; sweet springs issued from the ground; in the year of pacifying Chen, dragons guided the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: At first ascending the throne I received the tortoise chart; moved the capital and fixed the cauldron; sweet springs issued from the ground; in the year of pacifying Chen, dragons guided the fleet.

sentences.zh: 省俗巡方，展禮東岳，盲者得視，瘖者得言，復有躄人，忽然能步。

translations.literal: Inspecting customs and touring the regions, performing rites at the Eastern Peak; the blind gained sight, the mute gained speech; again there was a lame man who suddenly could walk.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting customs and touring the regions, I performed rites at the Eastern Peak; the blind gained sight, the mute speech; a lame man suddenly could walk.

sentences.zh: 自開皇已來，日近北極，行於上道，晷度延長。

translations.literal: From Kaihuang onward, the sun drew near the North Pole, traveling the upper path; the gnomon's shadow lengthened.
translations.idiomatic: From Kaihuang onward the sun drew near the North Pole, traveling the upper path; the gnomon's shadow lengthened.

sentences.zh: 天啟太平，獸見一角，改元仁壽，楊樹生松。

translations.literal: Heaven opened the Great Peace; a beast appeared with one horn; the reign title changed to Renshou; poplar trees bore pine.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven opened the Great Peace; a beast with one horn appeared; the reign title changed to Renshou; poplar trees bore pine branches.

sentences.zh: 石魚彰合符之徵，玉龜顯永昌之慶，山圖石瑞，前後繼出，皆載臣姓名，褒紀國祚。

translations.literal: Stone fish displayed the sign of matching tally; jade tortoise showed the omen of eternal prosperity; mountain charts and stone portents appeared in succession—all bearing your subject's name, praising and recording the dynasty's fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Stone fish displayed signs of matching tally; jade tortoise showed omens of eternal prosperity; mountain charts and stone portents appeared in succession—all bearing my name, praising and recording the dynasty's fortune.

sentences.zh: 經典諸緯，爰及玉龜，文字義理，遞相符會。

translations.literal: Classics and various weft texts, extending to jade tortoises—their characters' meaning and principle successively corresponded.
translations.idiomatic: Classics, various weft texts, and jade tortoise inscriptions—their characters' meaning and principle successively corresponded.

sentences.zh: :宮城之內，及在山谷，石變為玉，不可勝數。

translations.literal: : Within the palace city and in mountain valleys, stones transformed to jade—countless.
translations.idiomatic: Within the palace city and in mountain valleys, stones transformed to jade beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 桃區一嶺，盡是琉璃，黃銀出於神山，碧玉生於瑞巘。

translations.literal: One ridge in the peach district—all was glazed crystal; yellow silver issued from the numinous mountain; green jade grew on the auspicious peak.
translations.idiomatic: One ridge in the peach district was entirely glazed crystal; yellow silver issued from the numinous mountain; green jade grew on the auspicious peak.

sentences.zh: 多楊山響，三稱國興，連雲山聲，萬年臨國。

translations.literal: Mount Duoyang resounded; three times proclaimed the state's rise; Mount Lianyun sounded; ten thousand years the state draws near.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Duoyang resounded, three times proclaiming the state's rise; Mount Lianyun sounded, ten thousand years the state draws near.

sentences.zh: 野鵝降天，仍住池沼，神鹿入苑，頻賜引導。

translations.literal: Wild geese descended from Heaven and remained in pools and marshes; numinous deer entered the park, repeatedly granted guidance.
translations.idiomatic: Wild geese descended from Heaven and remained in pools and marshes; numinous deer entered the imperial park, repeatedly granted guidance.

sentences.zh: 騶虞見質，遊驎在野，鹿角生於楊樹，龍湫出於荊谷。

translations.literal: Zouyu appeared in substance; the roaming qilin in the wild; deer horns grew on poplar trees; dragon pool issued from the thorn valley.
translations.idiomatic: Zouyu appeared in the flesh; the roaming qilin in the wild; deer horns grew on poplar trees; a dragon pool issued from the thorn valley.

sentences.zh: 慶雲發彩，壽星垂耀。

translations.literal: Auspicious clouds issued color; the longevity star hung radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious clouds issued color; the longevity star hung its radiance.

sentences.zh: 宮殿樓閣，咸出靈芝，山澤川原，多生寶物。

translations.literal: Palace halls and towers—all produced numinous fungus; mountains, marshes, rivers, and plains—many produced precious things.
translations.idiomatic: Palace halls and towers all produced numinous fungus; mountains, marshes, rivers, and plains produced many precious things.

sentences.zh: 威香散馥，零露凝甘。

translations.literal: Powerful fragrance scattered perfume; zero dew condensed sweetness.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful fragrance scattered perfume; zero dew condensed sweetness.

sentences.zh: 敦煌烏山，黑石變白，弘祿巖嶺，石華遠照。

translations.literal: Mount Wushan in Dunhuang—black stones turned white; Mount Honglu—stone flowers shone from afar.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Wushan in Dunhuang, black stones turned white; at Mount Honglu, stone flowers shone from afar.

sentences.zh: 玄狐玄豹，白兔白狼，赤雀蒼烏，野蠶天豆，嘉禾合穗，珍木連理。

translations.literal: Dark fox and dark leopard, white rabbit and white wolf, red sparrow and dark bird, wild silkworm and heavenly bean, fine grain with combined ears, precious trees with joined trunks.
translations.idiomatic: Dark fox and dark leopard, white rabbit and white wolf, red sparrow and dark bird, wild silkworm and heavenly bean, fine grain with combined ears, precious trees with joined trunks.

sentences.zh: 神瑞休徵，洪恩景福，降賜無疆，不可具紀。

translations.literal: Numinous portents and auspicious signs, vast grace and glorious blessings—descending and bestowing without limit, impossible to record fully.
translations.idiomatic: Numinous portents and auspicious signs, vast grace and glorious blessings—descending and bestowing without limit, impossible to record fully.

sentences.zh: 此皆昊天上帝，爰降明靈，矜愍蒼生，寧靜海內。

translations.literal: All this is August Heaven Supreme Lord, descending and bestowing bright spirits, pitying the dark-born people, bringing quiet to the land within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: All this is August Heaven Supreme Lord, descending and bestowing bright spirits, pitying the dark-born people, bringing quiet to the land within the seas.

sentences.zh: 故錫茲嘉慶，咸使安樂，豈臣微誠，所能上感。

translations.literal: Therefore bestowing this fine celebration, making all secure and happy—how could your subject's slight sincerity be able to move above!
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestowing this fine celebration, making all secure and happy—how could my slight sincerity move Heaven above!

sentences.zh: 虔心奉謝，敬薦玉帛犧齊粢盛庶品，燔祀于昊天上帝。

translations.literal: With reverent heart offering thanks, respectfully presenting jade silks, sacrificial victims, pure offerings, sacrificial grain, and various items—burning sacrifice to August Heaven Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: With reverent heart I offer thanks, respectfully presenting jade silks, sacrificial victims, pure offerings, sacrificial grain, and various items—burning sacrifice to August Heaven Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 皇考太祖武元皇帝，配神作主。

translations.literal: The deceased father Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan, paired as spirit and host.
translations.idiomatic: The deceased Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan is paired as spirit and host.

sentences.zh: 大業元年，孟春祀感帝，孟冬祀神州，改以高祖文帝配。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daye, first spring sacrificed to the Responsive Emperor; first winter sacrificed to the Spirit of the Central Land—changed to use High Ancestor Emperor Wen as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In Daye 1, the first spring month sacrificed to the Responsive Emperor; the first winter month to the Spirit of the Central Land—both changed to use High Ancestor Emperor Wen as associate.

sentences.zh: 其餘並用舊禮。

translations.literal: The rest all used old rites.
translations.idiomatic: All other rites used the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 十年，冬至祀圓丘，帝不齋于次。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound—the emperor did not fast at the fasting lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, at the winter solstice Round Mound sacrifice, the emperor did not fast at the fasting lodge.

sentences.zh: 詰朝，備法駕，至便行禮。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day, with full imperial escort, he arrived and immediately performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day, with full imperial escort, he arrived and immediately performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 是日大風，帝獨獻上帝，三公分獻五帝。

translations.literal: That day a great wind blew; the emperor alone offered to the Supreme Lord; the Three Dukes separately offered to the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: That day a great wind blew; the emperor alone offered to the Supreme Lord; the Three Dukes separately offered to the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，御馬疾驅而歸。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he galloped his horse swiftly and returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, he galloped swiftly back.

sentences.zh: 明堂在國之陽。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall was in the yang of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall stood in the capital's yang sector.

sentences.zh: 梁初，依宋、齊，其祀之法，猶依齊制。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Liang, following Song and Qi, its sacrificial methods still followed Qi regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Liang, following Song and Qi precedent, its sacrificial methods still followed Qi regulations.

sentences.zh: 禮有不通者，武帝更與學者議之。

translations.literal: Where the rites were obstructed, Emperor Wu again deliberated with scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Where the rites were deficient, Emperor Wu deliberated again with scholars.

sentences.zh: 舊齊儀，郊祀，帝皆以袞冕。

translations.literal: Old Qi regulations: at suburban sacrifice, the emperor all wore the ceremonial robe.
translations.idiomatic: Old Qi regulations: at suburban sacrifice, the emperor always wore the ceremonial robe.

sentences.zh: 至天監七年，始造大裘，而明堂儀注猶云袞服。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianjian, the great fur robe was first made—yet the Bright Hall ritual regulations still said ceremonial robe.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 7, the great fur robe was first made—yet Bright Hall ritual regulations still prescribed the ceremonial robe.

sentences.zh: 十年，儀曹郎朱异以為：「禮大裘而冕，祭昊天上帝。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Director of Ritual Affairs Zhu Yi held: "The Rites: great fur robe and cap—sacrifice to August Heaven Supreme Lord."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Director of Ritual Affairs Zhu Yi argued: "The Rites prescribe the great fur robe and cap for sacrifice to August Heaven Supreme Lord."

sentences.zh: 五帝亦如之。

translations.literal: The Five Emperors likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors likewise."

sentences.zh: 良由天神高遠，義須誠質，今從汎祭五帝，理不容文。

translations.literal: Truly because celestial spirits are high and distant—in meaning one must be sincere and simple; now following the general sacrifice of the Five Emperors—in principle ornament is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Since celestial spirits are high and distant, sincerity and simplicity are required; in the general sacrifice of the Five Emperors, ornament is inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 」於是改服大裘。

translations.literal: " Thereupon dress was changed to the great fur robe.
translations.idiomatic: Dress was therefore changed to the great fur robe.

translations.idiomatic: The Record also says: "Yu Shun used earthenware zun."

translations.idiomatic: Unlike August Heaven, whose meaning transcends image—though called the same as the suburb, it should differ slightly.

translations.idiomatic: Water and soil products, vegetables and fruits should still be offered—but only four fruits: pear, jujube, orange, and chestnut; four pickled vegetables: ginger, reed, sunflower, and leek; four grains: husked rice, millet, panicum, and fine millet.

sentences.zh: 自此以外，郊所無者，請並從省除。

translations.literal: From this outward, what the suburb lacks—request all be reduced and removed.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these, whatever the suburb lacks should be eliminated.

translations.idiomatic: Initially, Erudite Ming Shanbin's ritual regulations prescribed that Bright Hall sacrifice to the Five Emperors begin with the Red Emperor.

translations.literal: Yi again held: "The Bright Hall since it generally sacrifices to the Five Emperors—cannot have fixed precedence; ascending the eastern steps—it is appropriate to begin with the Green Emperor."

translations.idiomatic: The suburb values substance and uses pottery and gourd; the ancestral temple values ornament and properly uses carved stands.

sentences.zh: 明堂之禮，既方郊為文，則不容陶匏，比廟為質，又不應彫俎。

translations.literal: Bright Hall's rite—since more ornamented than the suburb, then pottery and gourd is not permitted; compared to the temple as substance, then carved stands are not appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hall rites are more ornamented than the suburb—pottery and gourd is inappropriate; yet compared to the temple they are more substance—carved stands are also inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 斟酌二途，須存厥衷，請改用純漆。

translations.literal: Weighing the two paths—must preserve the mean; request to change to pure lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Balancing the two, we propose pure lacquer vessels.

translations.literal: All request to stop libation and the method of presenting the stand.

translations.literal: Examining the Record: "The suburb uses a special victim;"
translations.idiomatic: The Record states: "The suburb uses a special victim;"

translations.literal: Also says "Heaven and Earth's ox—horns like mulberry buds and chestnuts."

translations.literal: The Five Emperors being called celestial spirits—in principle there is no three-victim sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Five Emperors are celestial spirits, a three-victim sacrifice is inappropriate in principle.

sentences.zh: 而毛詩我將篇，云祀文王於明堂，有『維羊維牛』之說。

translations.literal: Yet in the Mao Odes' "I Will" poem—sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall—there is the saying "both sheep and ox."
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Mao Odes' "I Will" poem, sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall, says "both sheep and ox."

sentences.zh: 良由周監二代，其義貴文，明堂方郊，未為極質，故特用三牲，止為一代之制。

translations.literal: Truly because Zhou observed the two dynasties—its meaning valued ornament; the Bright Hall compared to the suburb was not yet ultimate substance—therefore specially used three victims—only as a single generation's regulation.
translations.idiomatic: This was because Zhou observed the two preceding dynasties and valued ornament; the Bright Hall, compared to the suburb, was not yet ultimate simplicity—hence three victims were specially used, as a single generation's regulation.

sentences.zh: 今斟酌百王，義存通典，蔬果之薦，雖符周禮，而牲牢之用，宜遵夏、殷。

translations.literal: Now weighing the hundred kings—meaning preserving the universal canon; vegetables and fruits' offerings—though matching the Rites of Zhou; yet victim use—should follow Xia and Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Weighing all previous kings and preserving the universal canon: vegetables and fruits match the Rites of Zhou, but victim use should follow Xia and Yin.

sentences.zh: 請自今明堂止用特牛，既合質文之中，又見貴誠之義。

translations.literal: From now on the Bright Hall only uses a special ox—both fitting the mean of substance and ornament, and showing the meaning of honoring sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth the Bright Hall should use only a special ox—fitting the balance of substance and ornament and honoring sincerity.

sentences.zh: 」帝並從之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor followed all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted all of these proposals.

translations.literal: Before this, the emperor wished to make revisions—he then issued an imperial decree, and with ministers and subjects refined the meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the emperor had wished to make revisions—he issued an imperial decree and refined the meaning with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「明堂準大戴禮：『九室八牖，三十六戶。

translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan, following the Received Spiritual Contract, also says "round above square below" and "eight windows reaching in four directions."

sentences.zh: 明堂之義，本是祭五帝神，九室之數，未見其理。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall's meaning fundamentally is sacrificing to the Five Emperors spirits—the number of nine chambers—its principle is not seen.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall's fundamental purpose is sacrificing to the Five Emperors spirits—the rationale for nine chambers is not evident.

sentences.zh: 若五堂而言，雖當五帝之數，向南則背叶光紀，向北則背赤熛怒，東向西向，又亦如此，於事殊未可安。

translations.literal: If speaking of five halls—though matching the Five Emperors' number—facing south then backs Leaf Light Era; facing north then backs Red Blazing Anger; east facing west facing—likewise so—in the affair especially not yet acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: If five halls are proposed—though matching the Five Emperors' number—facing south backs the Leaf Light Era; facing north backs Red Blazing Anger; east and west likewise—in principle this is unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 且明堂之祭五帝，則是總義，在郊之祭五帝，則是別義。

translations.literal: And the Bright Hall's sacrifice to the Five Emperors—then is the general meaning; the suburb's sacrifice to the Five Emperors—then is the separate meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hall sacrifice to the Five Emperors expresses the general meaning; suburban sacrifice to the Five Emperors, the separate meaning.

translations.idiomatic: In principle, the Bright Hall fundamentally has no chambers."

translations.literal: Since three places—then there is the meaning of left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Since there are three places, the left and right distinction applies.

translations.literal: Within the encampment walls, outside the Bright Hall—then there is the bay name; therefore called Bright Hall left and right bays.
translations.idiomatic: Within the encampment walls, outside the Bright Hall—these are the bays; hence Bright Hall left and right bays.

sentences.zh: 以此而言，聽朔之處，自在五帝堂之外，人神有別，差無相干。

translations.literal: By this speaking—the new-moon audience's place—naturally outside the Five Emperors' hall; human and spirit have distinction—nearly without mutual involvement.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the new-moon audience naturally occurs outside the Five Emperors' hall; human and spirit are distinct and do not interfere.

sentences.zh: 」其議是非莫定，初尚未改。

translations.literal: " The debate's right and wrong was not fixed; at first still not revised.
translations.idiomatic: The debate remained unresolved; no revision was made at first.

translations.idiomatic: The decree read: "Approved."

translations.literal: In the central six bays six seats were installed—all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: In the central six bays six seats were installed, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 東來第一青帝，第二赤帝，第三黃帝，第四白帝，第五黑帝。

translations.idiomatic: From the east: first the Green Emperor, second the Red Emperor, third the Yellow Emperor, fourth the White Emperor, fifth the Black Emperor.

translations.idiomatic: Associate lords collectively shared sacrifice with the Five Emperors—on the eastern steps above, facing west.

translations.idiomatic: Behind the great hall stood five small halls serving as the five assistant chambers.

sentences.zh: 陳制，明堂殿屋十二間。

translations.literal: Chen regulations: Bright Hall hall twelve bays.
translations.idiomatic: Chen regulations: the Bright Hall hall had twelve bays.

sentences.zh: 中央六間，依齊制，安六座。

translations.literal: Central six bays—following Qi regulations, six seats installed.
translations.idiomatic: The central six bays, following Qi regulations, held six seats.

sentences.zh: 四方帝各依其方，黃帝居坤維，而配饗坐依梁法。

translations.literal: Four Direction Emperors each according to their direction; Yellow Emperor at the southwest corner; associate feast seat following Liang method.
translations.idiomatic: Four Direction Emperors each according to their direction; the Yellow Emperor at the southwest corner; the associate feast seat following Liang method.

sentences.zh: 武帝時，以德帝配。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wu, the Virtue Emperor was paired.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu, the Virtue Emperor was paired.

sentences.zh: 文帝時，以武帝配。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wen, Emperor Wu was paired.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wen, Emperor Wu was paired.

sentences.zh: 廢帝已後，以文帝配。

translations.literal: After Emperor Fei, Emperor Wen was paired.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Fei, Emperor Wen was paired.

sentences.zh: 牲以太牢，粢盛六飯，鈃羹果蔬備薦焉。

translations.literal: Victims used the great victim; sacrificial grain six meals; tripod soup, fruits and vegetables fully offered.
translations.idiomatic: Victims used the great victim; sacrificial grain comprised six meals; tripod soup, fruits, and vegetables were fully offered.

sentences.zh: 後齊採周官考工記為五室，周採漢三輔黃圖為九室，各存其制，而竟不立。

translations.literal: Later Qi adopted the Rites of Zhou Artificer's Record for five chambers; Zhou adopted the Han Three Assistants Yellow Chart for nine chambers—each preserved its system, yet ultimately neither was built.

sentences.zh: 高祖平陳，收羅杞梓，郊丘宗社，典禮粗備，唯明堂未立。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor pacified Chen, he gathered talented men; suburban mounds, ancestral temple, and altars of soil and grain—canonical rites were roughly complete—only the Bright Hall was not yet built.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor pacified Chen, he gathered talented men; suburban mounds, ancestral temple, and altars of soil and grain were roughly complete—only the Bright Hall remained unbuilt.

translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang 13, an edict ordered deliberation.

translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Niu Hong, Imperial Academy Director Xin Yanzhi, and others fixed the deliberation—the account is in Hong's biography.

translations.idiomatic: Later Inspector-General Yuwen Kai, following the Monthly Ordinance, made a Bright Hall wooden model—double eaves, multiple halls, five chambers reaching in four directions; all dimensions had standards—and presented it.

sentences.zh: 高祖異之，命有司於郭內安業里為規兆。

translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor was impressed and ordered the site established at Anyeli within the outer city.

translations.idiomatic: Just as he wished to build on a grand scale, he ordered further detailed fixing; Confucian scholars debated without resolution.

sentences.zh: 弘等又條經史正文重奏。

translations.idiomatic: Hong and others again submitted the canonical and historical texts.

translations.idiomatic: Objections were numerous; deliberation continued without resolution—and the project was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 及大業中，愷又造明堂議及樣奏之。

translations.literal: In the Daye era, Kai again made Bright Hall deliberation and model to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daye era, Kai again submitted Bright Hall deliberation and a model.

sentences.zh: 煬帝下其議，但令於霍山採木，而建都興役，其制遂寢。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang sent down the deliberation—but only ordered timber cut at Mount Huo; yet capital construction and labor projects—the institution was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang sent down the deliberation—but only ordered timber cut at Mount Huo; capital construction and labor projects ultimately shelved the institution.

sentences.zh: 終隋代，祀五方上帝，止於明堂，恒以季秋在雩壇上而祀。

translations.literal: Through the Sui dynasty, sacrifice to the Five Direction Supreme Lords—only at the Bright Hall—always in late autumn at the rain-prayer altar.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Sui dynasty, sacrifice to the Five Direction Supreme Lords occurred only at the Bright Hall—always in late autumn at the rain-prayer altar.

sentences.zh: 其用幣各於其方。

translations.literal: Silks used each according to its direction.
translations.idiomatic: Silks were used according to each direction.

sentences.zh: 人帝各在天帝之左。

translations.literal: Human Emperors each to the left of the Heavenly Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Human Emperors each stood to the left of the Heavenly Emperors.

sentences.zh: 太祖武元皇帝在太昊南，西向。

translations.literal: Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan south of Taihao, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Founding Ancestor Emperor Wuyuan stood south of Taihao, facing west.

sentences.zh: 五官在庭，亦各依其方。

translations.literal: Five Officials in the courtyard—each also according to its direction.
translations.idiomatic: Five Officials stood in the courtyard, each according to its direction.

sentences.zh: 牲用犢十二。

translations.literal: Victims used twelve calves.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve calves were used as victims.

sentences.zh: 皇帝、太尉、司農行三獻禮于青帝及太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor, Grand Commandant, and Minister of Agriculture performed three offerings to the Green Emperor and the Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, Grand Commandant, and Minister of Agriculture performed three offerings to the Green Emperor and the Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 自餘有司助奠。

translations.literal: The rest of the relevant offices assisted in offering.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining relevant offices assisted in the offerings.

sentences.zh: 祀五官於堂下，行一獻禮。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to the Five Officials below the hall—performing one offering.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Officials were sacrificed to below the hall with a single offering.

sentences.zh: 有燎。

translations.literal: There was firewood burning.
translations.idiomatic: Firewood was burned.

sentences.zh: 其省牲進熟，如南郊儀。

translations.literal: Inspecting victims and presenting cooked offerings—followed the Southern Suburb regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting victims and presenting cooked offerings followed Southern Suburb regulations.
